summary: Bradford's Instagram record on safety and crime is extensive and centers on a recurring theme that Toronto "feels less safe." Bradford ties this to specific files: TTC safety (motion to place officers in all subway stations, improve lighting/cleanliness, build platform edge doors), encampments near schools/daycares/playgrounds (a 200m/48-hour clearance proposal), bubble zones around places of worship, schools, and daycares (advocacy from 2024 through passage in May 2025), gun violence ("no bail, go to jail"), and youth violence prevention via community partnerships. Bradford also pushed motorized watercraft restrictions at Woodbine Beach, jet ski licensing, road safety/Vision Zero measures, school safety zones, automated speed enforcement, and Bail Compliance Units inside Toronto Police. Bradford repeatedly opposes Mayor Chow's encampment protocol and police budget cuts, and supports fully funding the police.

key_positions.stance: Supports placing police officers in all TTC subway stations, plus improved lighting, cleanliness standards, and platform edge doors
Opposes encampments near schools, daycares, and playgrounds, proposing a 200-metre exclusion zone with 48-hour removal after report
Supports bubble zone bylaws creating safe access areas around places of worship, schools, and daycares
States Toronto has experienced rising antisemitism and hate crimes and opposes hate-motivated attacks on Jewish, Muslim, and other communities
Supports fully funding Toronto Police and opposed cuts to the Police Board-approved budget
Supports a 'no bail, go to jail' policy for anyone who fires a gun in Toronto and creating Bail Compliance Units within TPS
Supports tackling youth violence by funding community-embedded organizations rather than expanding city bureaucracy
Supports motorized watercraft exclusion zones at Woodbine and Cherry Beaches, jet ski licensing, and tougher enforcement
Supports road-safety/Vision Zero interventions including speed humps, school safety zones, automated speed enforcement, and lower speed limits
Opposes vandalism of speed cameras and calls current city reinstallation approach ineffective
Characterizes Mayor Chow as insufficiently prioritizing community safety, transit safety, and encampment clearing
Supports a non-police led pilot response to non-violent crisis calls and broader policing reform
